main_text.p: liquo, describitque per aerem quasi arcum, seu potius lineam parabolicam. Hinc est cur lapis neque minus altum tendat, quàm si à sola iaceretur manu; neque minus antrorsum, quàm si navi tantum proucheretur. Nam linea parabolica est quidem prolixior, quàm simpliciter sursum, & deorsum perpendicularis; verùm ad hoc supplet incussio à navi; & prolixior etiam, quàm simplex progressio; verùm ad hoc supplet impressio à manu. Hæc explicatio duo continet. Primum, quòd proiectum à motore translato moueatur parabolicè. Secundum, quòd motus antrorsum, & sursum non impediant se; unde mobile habere debeat eundem progressum ante, ac si ante solummodo perget; ret; eundemque motum sursum, ac si dumtaxat moueretur sursum.

page.notes: The text is in a single column with short indented lines in the centre; the lines "ante solummodo perget ;" and "eundemque motum sur- sum, ac si dumta- xat moueretur" are set in a narrowing centred block and are transcribed as running text with line breaks lost. The symbols (*⁎*) and (†) are printed as separate centred marks below the text, followed by a cross symbol (✥). Lower part of the page is faint and partly illegible.
